pages.text: At the last stop that evening, Dad filled a big washroom tub with warm water. "Bath time!" Bami wriggled after a day of play. "I hate baths... I'll sleep without washing!"

"I hate water on my head! I hate stinging eyes!" Bami put a towel over their head and fled to the sleeping car. Summer sunset glowed beyond the river bridge. Bami curled beside Nabi by the window. "No bath!" Dad smiled.
Beside Nabi, Bami's feathers felt sticky and itchy after playing all day. Nabi sniffed and nudged Bami away with a tail. "Do I smell?" Bami scratched their feathers.
Dad approached carrying a yellow toy duck in his beak. "Forget a bath. Want a ride on the bubble train?" Bami's eyes widened. "What's that?"
Dad stirred soap into the tub. White bubbles rose like mountains! The yellow duck floated on top. The tub became a bubble train. "A real bubble train!" Bami's eyes shone.
Dad whispered, "Three stations! First, the hair-washing waterfall. Second, the soapy snowman. Last, rinse and sparkle!" "How do we start?" "Splash into the bubble tub!"
Bami jumped in! Dad poured gentle cupfuls over their head like a waterfall, then used a bath brush to make a foamy snowman. Splashing with toy ducks was fun! "Splash into the bubble tub!"
Rinsed and out, Bami's feathers felt fluffy and fresh. The stickiness stayed in the tub! Bami spread their wings and shook sparkling drops. Nabi nuzzled their leg. "Baths are this much fun?"
Now Bami knew the stations. "One, hair-washing waterfall! Two, soapy snowman! Three, rinse and sparkle!" Next evening at the last stop, Bami ran to the washroom first. "Another bubble-train ride!"
Dad hugged fluffy Bami. "Clean, sparkling feathers!" Baths weren't frightening anymore. They were the most exciting water play. Splash into the bubble tub!
